The path from Lovastatin to Hmgcr is reinforced by the lowest common ancestor (LCA) of Lovastatin and Pravastatin, which is the Hmg-Coa Reductase Inhibitor class. The evidence also indicates that Pravastatin binds to Hmgcr, further solidifying the connection between Lovastatin and Hmgcr. The mechanism is mechanistically sound, as statins are known to inhibit Hmgcr, and the observed scores suggest a plausible relationship.
